title: "Main: Interactive Cusp Catastrophe Tool"
output: html_document
---

Our group project lets you visualize and plot data to a cusp catastrophe graph. 

With this document, you can run the base visualization module, the data analysis module, and the appearance module. 


## 1: Setup

All source code is loaded from 'X', while this document exposes the high-level interfaces needed. 

```{r}
#function copied from example repo
invisible(lapply(c("knitr", "shiny", "plotly", "colourpicker", "shinyjs"), function(package) {
  if (!requireNamespace(package, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(package, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
  }
}))



source("app_modules/base_model.R")
source("app_modules/data_analysis_module.R")
shinyApp(ui, server)#runs the app
```
